question.text: A Cat III AIF sold 3,00,000 units of Class A (cost Rs. 1000/unit, sold at Rs. 1225/unit) held for >12 months. LTCG?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** LTCG = 3,00,000 × (1225 − 1000) = Rs. 6,75,00,000 = Rs. 6.75 crore. **The Trap:** Other values don't match arithmetic. **Cross-Exam Context:** Example 3 in workbook. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Tax on Rs. 6.75 crore LTCG at 12.5% = ~Rs. 84 lakh before surcharge/cess.
